text:
nina: Drafting internal note for release v2.3.1-alpha. Canary planned tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need agreement on pin, rollback gates, and who sends ops blast.

nina: "Release v2.3.1-alpha: incremental serving runtime fixes (latency regressions & GC tuning). No API schema changes."

leo: Looks good. Suggest we pin to v2.3.1-alpha for the canary and then flip to v2.3.1 on full rollout.

jun: Rollback proposal: trigger rollback if p95 latency increases >40% for 5m OR 5xx rate >1% for 5m. Also add an abort if downstream queue backlog grows >2000.

vivian: Ops can send the internal blast. I'll monitor the canary window and coordinate oncall. Can we keep external release notes on hold until T+24h?

nina: Agreed on pin naming and hold on public notes. Update: change rollback latency threshold to +30% over baseline for 10m to be less noisy.

leo: Ack. Baseline is current prod median; record before deploy. Add runbook pointer: https://go/release/rt-runbook

deploy-bot: SCHEDULE: canary for service "runtime-serving" at 1712348800. Command: `/deploy canary runtime-serving v2.3.1-alpha --window 02:00-04:00UTC --pin-to v2.3.1-alpha`

jun: Rollback command: `/deploy rollback runtime-serving last-stable`  ops to run if gates trip. Document in runbook which team takes primary.

vivian: Final internal snippet to post (ops):

vivian: "Internal: v2.3.1-alpha canary tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC for runtime-serving. Pin: v2.3.1-alpha. Fixes for latency and GC tuning; no API changes; no customer data migration. Rollback gates: p95 latency +30% sustained 10m, 5xx >1% for 5m, queue backlog >2000. Ops lead: @vivian. Public notes embargoed until T+24h."

nina: Thanks all. @deploy-bot confirm heartbeat cadence and notify channel when canary starts. React :eyes: if you reviewed.
